dataset: National Heritage List for England (NHLE) - Listed Buildings as polygons, first-party data-download catalogue
evidence_slice: Historic England's official Data Downloads page states that the National Heritage List for England is the official up-to-date register and publishes Listed Buildings as polygons through the Open Data Hub, available under the Open Government Licence. The selected first-party catalogue window is dataset-level and does not expose a record-level Exeter feature, polygon coordinates, or record-bound building identity/type-use payload. It therefore establishes source-area availability only, not a physical building footprint or parcel progress.

field_evidence.footprint: The first-party Historic England page confirms a Listed Buildings polygon dataset exists, but the selected catalogue window provides no record-level Exeter polygon coordinates.
field_evidence.type_use: No record-bound Exeter type/use payload is exposed in this dataset-level catalogue window.
field_evidence.heritage: Historic England identifies the NHLE as the official up-to-date register and publishes Listed Buildings as polygons via the Open Data Hub.
